headline: Spain's Suffocation Survives Wasteful Finishing
story: Spain's suffocating dominance—57 per cent possession against Uruguay's 33—lacked the usual Spanish flourish. They recovered possession efficiently (12.9 seconds) and probed, but never destroyed. Uruguay's 4-1-4-1 absorbed the pressure, and at 42 minutes, Spain converted a modest chance (0.14 xG) when superior volume should have yielded more. The South Americans' eight high-press phases showed defensive commitment; Spain's controlled aggression proved the difference, even if the margin never widened beyond one.

Spain should have killed it. In the 63rd minute, a clear chance (0.17 xG) was missed. Then, with six minutes remaining, one tested the post (0.38 xG)—the match's highest-quality opportunity, spurned. Uruguay finished with just one shot on target from 0.22 xG. Laporte (7.8 rating) marshalled an immaculate defence, while Llorente (7.4) and Simón (7.3) controlled tempo. A late red card for Canobbio (90+4) was punctuation, not plot. Spain's efficiency was imperfect but final.

keyMoment.text: Spain's only moment of clinical finishing in an otherwise suffocating possession display.

home.verdict: Discipline held. One lapse and lack of outlet proved fatal.
points: One shot on-target from 33 per cent possession unsustainable: need higher offensive yield or tactical shift.
Ball recovery lag (16.7s vs 12.9s) killed transition opportunity; convert faster or stop forcing turnovers fruitlessly.
53 forced turnovers wasted: execution breakdown after winning ball negated all defensive virtue.

away.verdict: Possession and precision combined to decide it. Nearly undone by waste.
points: Ball recovery dominance (12.9s vs 16.7s) allowed play dictation; superior frequency created the goal opportunity.
Early breakthrough (42') meant no need for second: possession control sufficed once ahead.
Risk survived: the 0.38 xG at 86' tested the post. Uruguay stay alive if more clinical.

statLine: Spain's five-fold xG advantage (1.12 to 0.22) compressed into a single goal—possession deciding what profligacy could not destroy.
